run_blaser_evaluation: run BLASER model evaluation on source and machine translation embedding files to compute quality scores
run_unsupervised_blaser: run unsupervised BLASER scoring when no model config or reference embeddings are provided
create_blaser_eval_config: create a BlaserEvalConfig dataclass with output directory, source embeddings, and MT embedding file paths
create_pytorch_model_config: create a PytorchModelConfig dataclass with config file and model checkpoint paths for supervised BLASER
compute_pearson_correlation: compute Pearson correlation between BLASER model predictions and human judgment labels
